purpose: return installed/running app inventory with bundle identifiers and safe state.

source.source_text: Purpose: return installed/running app inventory with bundle identifiers and safe state. Input: running_only?:boolean, include_installed?:boolean. Output: allowlist-relevant app metadata. Contract: L3 read_only; scope mac.app.read; target app_set; timeout 10000ms; cap 256KiB; network/filesystem none except approved app metadata discovery; secrets redacted; approval trusted_read; idempotent yes. Phase 4 planned.
